original.body:
Alert: Critical — Sensor VF-04 (North District Clinic, 10.72.14.08)

- Event: Temperature rise to 4.3°C (7.7°F) — sustained for 2 hours
- Time window: 2026-10-21 09:15 to 11:15
- Current reading: 3.8°C (3.8°C)
- Status: Alert not received by MCHD systems
- Integration: Not on MCHD network; vendor cloud only
- Action: Verify paper log (MCHD-F-40) for manual readings during event window.

This is a system-level alert. No local integration means no alert was routed to MCHD workstations, file shares, or email. The paper log remains the only record for this interval.
